title: Specify answer normalization
hints: Decide exactly which differences the metric ignores.
ASCII punctuation removal differs from replacing punctuation with spaces.
Do not silently add article removal or semantic matching.

title: Score acceptable references
hints: Treat references as alternative valid answers.
Normalize prediction and references under the same policy.
An empty reference set is invalid data, not a score of zero.

title: Score a continuation at the right offset
hints: Map every continuation target to its preceding logit.
The prompt supplies context but its targets do not contribute.
The final model row predicts a token outside the observed sequence.

title: Make length normalization explicit
hints: Keep summed and normalized scoring as explicit alternatives.
Divide by continuation token count only in normalized mode.
A tie chooses the earliest candidate.

title: Aggregate perplexity by token count
hints: Return to total NLL and token counts before aggregation.
Apply the exponential only after computing global mean NLL.
A mean of document perplexities changes both weighting and the nonlinear operation.

title: Count classification outcomes
hints: Fix the meaning of each axis.
Increment one true-row/predicted-column entry per case.
Keep declared empty classes in the matrix.

title: Distinguish macro and micro behavior
hints: Compute class scores from row and column counts.
Each class denominator is true count plus predicted count.
Macro includes zero-score absent classes under this contract.

title: Estimate uncertainty with paired resampling
hints: Keep each example’s two model scores paired.
Resample indices, then apply them to score differences.
Identical models produce exactly zero in every resample.

title: Align comparisons by identity
hints: Treat IDs as join keys, not presentation order.
Validate complete matching sets before sorting.
Sorting determines a stable index order for the seeded bootstrap.

title: Inspect performance slices
hints: Ask whether examples or groups receive equal weight.
Keep counts beside every group score.
The worst group can be invisible in a dominant-group micro average.

title: Measure calibration
hints: Group observations by confidence before measuring gaps.
Weight each bin by its number of observations.
Confidence one belongs to the final bin, not an out-of-range index.

title: Measure user-visible generation latency
hints: Separate the first token from continuation tokens.
Decode elapsed time starts at the first token timestamp.
One token has no decode interval and therefore no decode throughput estimate.

title: Run an auditable evaluation
hints: Expose only prompts to the prediction callback.
Preserve identities and every case in the denominator.
Propagate prediction failures rather than dropping difficult examples.

title: Publish a finite immutable report
hints: Validate JSON serialization before opening the destination.
Reject nonfinite values and preserve Unicode.
Hash the exact canonical bytes including their trailing newline.
